title: Real Betis and Real Sociedad face off at La Cartuja
seoTitle: Real Betis vs Real Sociedad: LaLiga Match Preview
subtitle: The Matchday 2 clash of the Spanish championship brings both teams together in Seville with various absences and new faces.
excerpt: Discover the details of the match between Real Betis and Real Sociedad at the La Cartuja Stadium in Seville for the Spanish championship.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: azcentral.com and The Arizona Republic, El Desmarque, COPE
contentHtml:
The clash between Real Betis and Real Sociedad captures the attention of football fans at the start of the competition. Both teams face off at the La Cartuja Stadium in Seville, in a match corresponding to Matchday 2 of the Spanish championship.

The context of the match at La Cartuja

The match takes place at the La Cartuja Stadium in Seville. The sporting event features a special security, mobility, and cleaning operation prepared by the city council around the stadium, including traffic closures in the vicinity.

Lineups and news for Real Betis

Real Betis comes into the fixture with the objective of securing their first three points of the season. The verdiblanco squad takes to the pitch with Valles, Bellerín, Bartra, Natan, Fran García, Facundo Bernal, Marc Roca, Fornals, Antony, Riquelme, and Cucho Hernández.

On the bench are Manu González, Valentín, Ángel Ortiz, Diego Llorente, Junior Firpo, Fidalgo, Deossa, Isco, Pablo García, and Iker Losada. The team has Isco Alarcón almost in full condition, Antony with no pubic issues, and Troy Parrott on the roster, although the Irish striker must wait a few more days to make his debut. Among the injury absences are Giovani Lo Celso, goalkeeper Diego Conde, Aitor Ruibal, and Uruguayan Gonzalo Petit, while Ez Abde has not been included due to physical ailments.

Real Sociedad's situation

Meanwhile, Real Sociedad faces its league debut with no new faces in terms of signings for this summer transfer window. The visiting team starts with Remiro; Aramburu, Jon Martín, Zubeldia, Sergio Gómez, Yangel Herrera, Carlos Soler; Take Kubo, Barrene, Sucic, and Oskarsson.

Waiting on the bench are Marrero, Aihen, Turrientes, Oyarzabal, Ochieng, Pacheco, Goti, Zakharyan, Carrera, Lebarbier, Marchal, and Beitia. The only confirmed absences for the San Sebastián side are Odriozola, Gorrotxategi, and Guedes.

Schedules and broadcasting in different countries

The match is played at midnight Arizona time, 1:00 PM in Mexico, and 9:00 PM in Spain. Fans in the United States can follow the match through ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, and Fubo. In Mexican territory, the broadcast is carried out by Sky Sports and Sky+, while in Spain it is broadcast via Movistar Plus+ LaLiga and its corresponding application.

With information from azcentral.com and The Arizona Republic, El Desmarque, COPE.
